evaluation_type: exact event-relationship match on annotated event subgraph

ground_truth.source: experiment notes and raw evidence, independent of correlation predictions

scored_scope.description: Counts exact expected-link matches only. Alternative event-level evidence pairings and predictions involving unlabeled events are unreviewed, not false positives.

limitations: Single development experiment; correlation rules were refined during investigation of this case, so this is not a blind or held-out result.
The positive edge list may not enumerate every valid event-level evidence pairing; relationship precision and F1 are not computed.
The 223k-scale ambient predictions are not fully labeled; unlabeled edges are not false positives.
No baseline comparison, event-detection metrics, false-positive rate, or timeline score is claimed; the chronology is partial.
